items.headline: $ARRR Exploit Mints 39.8M Coins Out of Thin Air
items.summary: Pirate Chain confirmed an exploit that created 39.8 million $ARRR. The network is live, but users are told not to move funds while devs work on recovery.

items.headline: $bOSMO Bug Breaks Backing, Compensation Plan Coming
items.summary: A contract bug left $bOSMO with little backing and still allows cheap minting, putting LPs at risk. Only holders before the snapshot will be compensated.

items.headline: $STRK Vote: Starknet Eyes Break From Ethereum
items.summary: Starknet opened a seven-day community vote on researching an independent Layer 1 over quantum risks. $STRK stakers and delegators get a direct say.

items.headline: $LDO: Lido Enables Direct ETH Staking From 4 L2s
items.summary: Lido now lets users stake ETH directly from four Layer 2s and receive $wstETH from local pools, while ETH is bridged and staked in the background.

items.headline: $AAVE V4 Arc Links Dollar-Euro Loans in One Pool
items.summary: Aave V4's Arc markets connect dollar and euro loans to shared liquidity, with a Forex market letting borrowers pledge EURC as collateral. $AAVE keeps expanding cross-currency DeFi.
